kevin: Heads up — customer reported duplicate billing after a streaming session fell back to a different route and retried a toolcall. short trace below.

maria: paste the trace?

kevin: ```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z stream start session=s-900 prefix=110
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z toolcall tc-A invoked (sidecar A)
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z client timeout -> sidecar A emits provisional meter(L=LR-900,pending=true,tokens=45,route=us-east-1)
2026-03-20T14:02:14Z router falls back to us-west-1, client reconnect resume_token=R-900
2026-03-20T14:02:15Z sidecar B replays prefix, retries toolcall tc-A' and emits confirmed meter(L=LR-900,pending=false,tokens=45,route=us-west-1)
Ledger ended up with both provisional(us-east-1) and confirmed(us-west-1) rows -> customer billed for 90 tokens
```

sasha: Classic route-handoff attribution bug. The provisional row never reconciled/merged because finalizer (sidecar B) couldn't find the provisional key in the ledger (different route namespace).

anita: I think two problems: 1) lack of a stable logical_request_id returned to client so retries create new logical entries, and 2) provisional rows are inserted per route without a reconciliation key.

jordan: UX fallout: console shows both rows and support sees customer anger. We should stop exposing raw provisional rows by default.

alex: Proposal: generate a server-side opaque LRID on original request, return LRID in stream handshake. All meter events include lrid. Router/sidecars must include lrid when emitting provisional or final meters. Ledger should dedupe by lrid and prefer final event.

maria: Telemetry change list: add lrid, provisional(bool), resume_token_hash, origin_route, final_token_count, provisional_ts. We need proto versioning and migration plan.

sasha: On implementation: finalizer might be a different service. We need a reconciliation policy: when final event arrives with same lrid, update the provisional row instead of inserting. Also add a tombstone TTL for orphan provisionals and a reconciliation backfill.

anita: For quota semantics: we should mark provisional as "reserved" capacity so it reduces concurrency/quota availability but doesn't appear as billed until confirmed. That reduces surprises where quotas are exhausted then suddenly freed post-confirmation.

jordan: Console changes: default view filters to confirmed only. Add an optional toggle "show pending/reserved" with clear tooltip. And a short banner on billing timeline: "Pending charges may be adjusted once sessions reconcile."

alex: Billing/legal: do we bill reserved tokens immediately in invoices? My preference: no. Only confirmed tokens are billed. Reservations affect live quota and soft quota alerts. Billing team to confirm.

kevin: Operational plan: 1) proto change PR (lrid+provisional+provisional_ts+resume_hash); 2) router/sidecar change to surface lrid and emit finalizer event from the owner; 3) ledger change to index by lrid and update-in-place when final arrives; 4) console default filter + toggle; 5) reconcile backfill job for last 14 days; 6) run canary.

maria: Add debug metadata in final event: provisional_row_id_hint (if present) and provisional_ts to help debug mismatches. We'll also emit a reconciliation_reason tag for events that cause update vs insert.

sasha: Edge cases: what if clients reuse resume_token across independent logical requests? LRID must be independent of resume_token and generated per logical request. Return lrid in the 101/handshake so client can echo it but must not be used as an authority to dedupe client-side.

anita: Backfill job: find provisional rows older than X hours that have matching final events (by resume_hash+session+chunk_offset heuristics) and merge them, then alert on mismatches. I'll scope runtime and costs.

jordan: One more: in cross-region failovers we might see different attribution routes. Ledger should store origin_route and final_attribution_route to preserve trace. Console should surface both routes in a single merged row.

alex: QA: add synthetic tests that simulate fallback, delayed finalizer, and GC of provisional. Also add a billing integration test to ensure invoices only include confirmed tokens.

billing-bot: note: billing policy review requested for "reserve vs bill" on 2026-03-20.

kevin: Thanks — I'll open tickets for proto + ledger + console + backfill and tag infra, router, billing, and support docs. Will include a canary plan and telemetry dashboard to watch provisional vs confirmed ratio.

sasha: Great. tiny ask: include a linkable debug id in the console merge view that opens the reconciliation trace so support can hand off quickly.

kevin: good idea. adding to tickets now, assigning to @anita for backfill and @maria for proto. Thanks all :bow:
